tooling.message:
fix: plan-only changes never redeploy, and the follow-ups from the first run's reviews

## Intent

Plan-only changes must never redeploy an app. A paths filter alone is not safe: GitHub may skip the run of a new main branch whose commits it already has, so an app's first publish could be lost. Two code reviews of the first creator run's fixes (#52) also found bugs and duplicated code.

## Key changes

- After main is created, the plan template checks that a Pages run started for that commit and starts one by hand if none did. The same fallback covers any later push of app changes. Pull requests still run the check on every change, because a check skipped by a paths filter stays pending.
- The plan, with its retrospective, is pushed before the listing pull request, and again at the end only if it changed.
- AGENTS.md and the plan template agree: push work only until the first publish, then main as the Commit tasks say, and never while a check fails.
- The default-branch check during publish is best-effort: a failed request is a notice, not a failed deploy.
- lernapps update never moves the runtime back to an older template version, and run from a tooling clone it names what it did not move and exits 1.
- The detection of a failing runtime test is proven on a real quiz app.
- Duplication removed: one runtime constant, one helper for the pinned templates, one rate-limit handling for both link rules, and less text repeated between the quiz and app skills.
